text: Everything has only run on Desmond's laptop so far. This lesson moves EmberStake onto Base Sepolia, a real public testnet.
A Hardhat deployment script deploys the contract, and Desmond verifies its source code on Basescan so anyone can read exactly what's running.
Julian repoints the indexer and API at the live deployment -- real RPC URL, real contract address, real deployment block.
The team runs one full stake-distribute-claim cycle on the public testnet together, and every number matches Basescan exactly.
Next: building the frontend staking dashboard on top of this live deployment.
